description: Owner PR B: private-execution migration left the BO reader on public Message fields. Preserve legacy message telemetry fallback and staff/forged-message denial. Surface complete private tokens/timings/turns/real tool traces, keep them out of shareable history. title: [zaq-emb.28] Project authorized private execution telemetry into persisted message information
